senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 3d cl. (अक्षति अक्ष्णोति)
1 To reach or obtain.
2 To pervade.
3 To accumulate.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A die, cubic or oblong, for playing with.
2 Part of a car.
3 A wheel.
4 A car.
5 A snake.
6 Law suit, legal proceedings.
7 Sacred knowledge.
8 The soul.
9 A seed of which Rosaries are made, in which sense it occurs mostly in composition, as, Rudrākṣa, Indrākṣa.
10 A Karṣa or weight of sixteen māṣas.
11 A tree bearing a medicinal fruit. (Terminalia belerica.)
12 A proper name. the son of RĀVAṆA.
13 A name of GARUḌA.
14 A person born blind.
15 Terrestrial latitude.
n. (-क्षं)
1 An organ of sense.
2 Sea salt.
3 Blue vitriol.
E.
अशु to pervade, Uṇādi affix स.

m. (-कः)
A tree. (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis, Rox.)
E.
अक्ष Beleric myrobalan, and क affix: from its resembling that plant; or the termination being a pleonastic affix, the word may have all the senses of the preceding: also read अक्षिक.

n. (-र्णः)
1 The hypothenuse, especially of the triangle formed with the gnomon of a dial and its shadow.
2 (In astronomy.) Argument of the latitude.

n. (-तं)
1 Fried grain, (in this sense it is also used in the mas. plu. -ताः).
2 A eunuch.
3 Whole grain.
f. (-ता)
A plant, named also Kāṅkarasriṅgī.
mfn. (-त-ता-तं.)
1 Uninjured, unhurt.
2 Whole, unbroken.
E.
अ neg. and क्षत torn, broken, &c.

f. (-निः)
A virgin.
E.
अक्षत and योनि pudendum.

m. (-कः)
A judge.
E.
अक्ष a law suit, दर्शक who sees; from दृश to see.

m. (-द्यूः)
A gambler, a dicer.
E.
अक्ष dice and द्यू who plays.

m. (-तः)
A gambler, a dicer.
n. (-तंः)
Gambling.
E.
अक्ष and द्यूत play or who plays: also अक्षद्यूत्.

n. (-कं)
Dispute at play.
E.
अक्ष and द्यूत with ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Effected or completed by gambling.
E.
आक्षद्यूत and ठक् aff.

m. (-दृक्)
A judge.
E.
अक्ष a law suit, and दृश् who sees.

m. (-वी)
A gamester.
E.
अक्ष a dice, and देविन् a player.

m. (-रः)
A plant, (Trophis aspera.) See साखोट.
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
One who holds dice &c.
E.
अक्ष and धर what holds.

m. (-त्तः)
A gamester, a gambler.
E.
अक्ष dice, and धूचै a rogue.

m. (-लः)
A bull, an ox.
E.
अक्ष a cart, धूर् its forepart, or धुर् a load, and तिल affix.

m. (-टः)
An arena, a boxing or wrestling ground; also read अक्षवाट.

m. (-कः)
A judge.
E.
अक्ष law suit, and पाट to arrange, affix वुन्.

m. (-कः)
A judge.
E.
as before with टक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A judge.
E.
अक्ष a law suit, पट to go, causal form, उक affix; also आक्षपाटिक.

m. (-दः)
A follower of the Nyāya system of philosophy.
E.
अक्ष contest, and पाद who goes; the Nyāya is the logical school; also आक्षपाद.

m. (-दः)
A logician.
E.
अक्ष dispute, पाद a division, अण affix; also अक्षपाद.

m. (-गः)
A degree of latitude.
E.
अक्ष and भाग a part.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Impatient, intolerant.
2 Unable, incompetent, impotent.
f. (-मा)
1 Impatience, intolerance.
2 Envy, impatience of another's success.
3 Inability, incapacity.
E.
अ neg. क्षमा patience.

f. (-ता)
Impatience, &c. See the last.

m. (-त्वं)
Impatience, &c. See अक्षम.

f. (-ला)
1 A rosary, a string of beads, especially of the seeds of the Eleocarpus.
2 The name of ARUNDHATĪ, wife of VAŚIṢṬHA, (from her wearing a rosary.)
E.
अक्ष a kind of seed or bead, and माला a necklace.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Durable, permanent, imperishable.
f. (-या)
The seventh day of a lunar month, which happens on a Sunday or Monday, and the fourth, which falls on a Wednesday.
E.
अ neg. and क्षै to waste or decay, aff. अच्.

f. (-ता)
Durability, imperishableness.
E.
ता added to the preceding.

f. (-या)
The third day of the lunar half of the month Vaiśākha. (April-May.)
E.
अक्षय durable, and तृतीया the third day: the consequences of meritorious actions performed on this day being permanent, as it is the first day of the Satya Yuga or the anniversary of creation.

n. (-त्वं)
Imperishableness.
E.
त्व added to अक्षय.

m. (-कं)
Heaven, the imperishable world or region.
E.
अक्षय and लोक world.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
n. (-रं)
BRAHM, the supreme being, (in this sense it is sometimes mas.)
2 Eternal beatitude, or exemption from further transmigration.
3 Religious austerity.
4 Moral merit.
5 The sky or atmosphere.
6 A letter of the alphabet.
7 A plant. (Achyranthes aspera.)
8 Water (in the dialect of the Vedas.)
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Unalterable.
2 Unperishable, undecayable^1.
E.
अशू to pervade, and सर Uṇādi affix.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-रः)
Accusation, calumny.
E.
आङ् before क्षर to go, affix घञ्.

m. (-ञ्चः)
A scribe, a writer.
E.
अक्षर letter, and चञ्च affix.

m. (-णः)
A scribe.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and चण affix.

m. (-नः)
A scribe.
E.
See the last word.

m. (-ञ्चः)
A scribe, a writer. See अक्षरचञ्च.

f. (-नी)
A pen.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and जननी a mother.

m. (-कः)
A scribe.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and जीवक who lives, i. e. who gets a livelihood by letters; also अक्षरजीविक and अक्षरजीविन्.

f. (-का)
A pen.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and तूलिका a brush.

m. (-सः)
1 Scripture, a writing.
2 The alphabet.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and विन्यास assemblage.

(-खः)
A scholar, a student.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and मुख commencement.

n. (-नं)
Scripture, a writing.
E.
अक्षर a letter, and अंस्थान placing, collecting.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a die, &c.
f. (-ती)
Gaming, playing with dice.
E.
अक्ष a die, and मतुप् possessive affix.

m. (-टः)
An amphitheatre for wrestling, the arena of a gymnasium.
E.
अक्ष contest, and वाट an enclosure, an area.

mfn. (-वित्)
Versed in law, or in play.
E.
अक्ष law or dice, and विद् who knows.

n. (-त्रं)
A rosary, a string of elaeocarpus^1 seeds so used.
E.
अक्ष and सूत्र a thread.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-शः)
A degree of latitude.
E.
अंक्ष and अंश a part.

n. (-ग्रं)
1 The fore part of a car.
2 The axle or bar to which the wheels are attached.
E.
अक्ष and अग्र fore part.

m. (-कः)
The pin of the axle of a carriage, the linchpin, also one at the extremity of the pole.
E.
अक्ष a cart, अग्र fore part, and कीलक a pin or bolt.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Impatience, intolerance.
2 Envy, impatience of another's superiority or success.
E.
अ neg. and क्षान्ति sufferance.

n. (-णं)
Such food as may be eaten during a season of mourning, religious observance, &c. as cow's milk, ghee, rice, kidney-beans, barley, sesamum, and sea or river salt.
E.
अ neg. क्षार alkali, लवण salt.

n. (-क्षि)
The eye.
E.
अश to pervade, and सि affix.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis.) See also अक्ष.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating or belonging to a die, to gambling, &c.
2 Won at dice.
m. (-कः)
A tree. (Morinda tinctoria.)
n. (-कं)
A gambling debt, money lost at play.
E.
अक्ष a die, &c. and ठञ् aff.

n. (-कः)
The eye-ball.
E.
अक्षि the eye, and कूटक a globe, or ball.

m. (-लः)
The ball or globe of the eye.
E.
अक्षि and गोल ball.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hateful, hated, disliked.
E.
अक्षि the eye, and गत gone.

f. (-रा)
The pupil of the eye.
E.
अक्षि and तारा a star.

n. (-क्ष्म)
The eye lash.
E.
अक्षि and पलक्ष्मन् lash.

n. (-ल)
A coat of the eye.
E.
अक्षि and पटल a coat.

m. (-जः)
A tree, (Pale Lodh.) See गालव.
n. (-वं)
Any medicament or collyrium for the eye.
E.
अक्षि the eye, and भेषज a remedy.

m. (-वः)
A plant. (Morunga).
n. (-वं)
Sea-salt. See अक्षीव.

m. (-वः)
A plant. (Guilandina or Hyperanthera morunga.)
n. (-वं)
Sea-salt.
E.
अक्ष to pervade, ईव aff.: it is also written अक्षिव and अक्षीव.
mfn. (-व-वा-वं)
Sober, not intoxicated.
E.
neg. and क्षीव intoxicated.

n. (-तं)
A glance or side look; one with the eye lids partly closed.
E.
अक्षि the eye, and कूशित from कूश to contract, with वि prefixed.

mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
1 Unpared, uncut, not comminuted.
2 Inexpert.
3 Unconquered.
E.
अ neg. क्षुण्ण cut.

f. (-ता)
1 Entireness, fulness.
2 Want of practice or conversancy.
E.
अ neg. क्षुण्णता spareness.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Unshaken, undisturbed, unagitated.
E.
अ neg. क्षब्ध shaken.

m. (-टः)
1 A tree, (described as a Pilu, growing in the hills.) See पीलु.
2 A walnut.
3 A tree bearing an oily nut, (Aleurites triloba.) Also written आखोट.
E.
अक्ष to pervade, and ओट aff.

m. (-टः)
A tree, (see पीलु,) growing in mountains: in Hindi, the corresponding name implies the walnut: see अक्षोट and आक्षोड.

m. (-डः)
See the preceding word, also आखोड.
E.
अक्ष to pervade, and ओड aff.

m. (-डः)
A kind of Pilu, a tree so named, (Careya arborea): see अक्षोड, अक्षोट and पीलु.

m. (-कः)
See अक्षोड.
E.
अक्षोड and कन् aff.

m. (-भः)
1 Firmness, absence of agitation.
2 The post to which an elephant is tied.
mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Unshaken, unagitated.
E.
अ priv. क्षोभ shaking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unshaken, unagitated, firm.
E.
अ neg. क्षोभित shaken.

f. (-णी)
A complete army, consisting of 1,09,350 foot, 65,610 horse, 21,870 chariots, and 21,870 elephants.
E.
अक्ष a carriage, ऊहिणी assemblage.

अक्ष्ण^1
n. (-क्ष्णं)
Time.
E.
अश to eat, and क्स्न Uṇādi aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160315. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/252. note: 'zn' usually not possible.

n. (-णं)
Fasting, or purification by fasting.
E.
आङ् before क्षप to endure, ल्युट् aff.

nf. (-णं-णा)
1 Calumnious accusation.
2 Abuse, reviling.
E.
आङ्, क्षर to go, with युच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Calumniated, falsely accused.
2 Accused of adultery or fornication.
3 Falsely accused, of such crimes in particular.
4 Guilty, criminal.
5 Reviled, abused.
E.
आङ्, क्षर to go, part. affix क्त.

m. (-णः)
A stake, a wager, a bet.
E.
आक्षिक and पण a wager.

mfn. (-पन्-पती-पत्)
1 Excelling, so as to reproach or put to shame others.
2 Reviling, abusing.
3 Tossing.
4 Sending.
E.
आङ् before क्षिप् to throw, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Cast, thrown, tossed.
2 Thrown down or away.
3 Borne, carried.
4 Reviled, abused, blamed, ridiculed.
5 Equal or equivalent to.
E.
आङ् before क्षिप to throw, क्त aff.

m. (-बः)
A plant, (Morunga guilandina and hyperanthera): see अक्षीब.

m. (-पः)
1 Throw, toss.
2 Abuse, reviling.
3 Censure, blame, reproach.
4 Attraction.
5 A figure in rhetoric, (irony.)
E.
आङ्, क्षिप to throw or send, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2 Convulsion, spasm.
3 A detractor, a calumniator or accuser.
4 A thrower.
E.
आङ् before क्षिप to toss, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Spiritual ignorance.
E.
अ neg. क्षेत्रज्ञ wise, and ष्यञ affix, the initial optionally long.

m. (-दः)
A Brahman of the Ṛkṣoda mountain.
E.
ऋक्षोद and अण् aff.

n. (-नं)
Hunting.
